allowed_actions.selection_boundary: Hold because aggregate approval, review, authority, or evidence remains unresolved.
Ask for missing approval, aggregate relationship, threshold, exception, or related-item evidence.
Route aggregate review without treating split packet status as approval.
Create a draft only if unresolved gaps remain visible and final payment readiness is not implied.
Stage split items only if unresolved gaps remain visible and final release is not implied.
Prepare payment only if shown records support it; unresolved aggregate gaps remain candidates.
Escalate ambiguity about aggregate approval, review, split context, or threshold status.
